subject: math
cluster: Identify and describe shapes (squares, circles, triangles, rectangles, hexagons, cubes, cones, cylinders, and spheres)

items.prompt: Is a circle flat (two-dimensional) or solid (three-dimensional)?

steps: Flat shapes are drawn on paper and are two-dimensional.
A circle is flat, so it is two-dimensional.

items.prompt: Is a cube flat or solid?

steps: A cube takes up space and you can hold it.

items.prompt: Is a square flat or solid?

steps: A square is drawn flat on paper, so it is two-dimensional.

items.prompt: Is a sphere flat or solid?

steps: A sphere, like a ball, takes up space, so it is solid.
Flat shapes include circles, squares, triangles, and rectangles.
Solid shapes include cubes, spheres, cones, and cylinders.
